zero-to-one-secrets 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill focused on helping users identify and hunt for business secrets in the "Zero to One" sense.
- Provides clear activation and skipping criteria to ensure the skill is used only for business opportunity questions, not security or credential topics.
- Includes a step-by-step, falsifiability-focused process for stress-testing business ideas or claimed differentiators.
- Supports adaptive guidance for both novice users (coaching mode) and experienced users (engine mode).
- Emphasizes searching underexplored areas and verifying claims with concrete, killable tests.
